files.statement: the control file connects paths, time settings, input metadata, routing decisions and output choices
the input guide requires river-network and runoff information and conditionally a remapping file

inputs.statement: variable and dimension names can be configured, so do not identify their semantics by spelling alone

inputs.variable: runoff on river-network HRUs vs another hydrological HRU system or grid
inputs.statement: the input guide distinguishes runoff already on river-network HRUs from runoff on another hydrological HRU system or grid; the latter cases require mapping into the river-network HRUs

outputs.variable: remapped HRU runoff / hillslope diagnostics / routed discharge / storage-related quantities
outputs.statement: the output guide distinguishes remapped HRU runoff, hillslope/instantaneous-runoff diagnostics, method-specific routed discharge and storage-related quantities

the channel guide explicitly allows upstream runoff accumulation without routing; it is useful for separating volume production from transport but is not evidence that timing or attenuation has been simulated
